hints.title: Rightmost Pivot
hints.text: Locate the rightmost index i where nums[i] is strictly less than nums[i+1].

hints.title: Minimal Suffix Successor
hints.text: Find the smallest value strictly greater than nums[i] to its right and swap them.

hints.title: Suffix Reversal
hints.text: Reverse the descending suffix starting at index i + 1 to achieve minimal lexicographical ordering.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def nextGreaterPermutation(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        # Next permutation of nums
        a = list(nums)
        n = len(a)
        i = n - 2
        while i >= 0 and a[i] >= a[i + 1]:
            i -= 1
        if i >= 0:
            j = n - 1
            while a[j] <= a[i]:
                j -= 1
            a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
        # Reverse suffix
        a[i + 1:] = reversed(a[i + 1:])
        return a
```

complexity.notes: Classic linear two-pointer next permutation algorithm.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all N! permutations is infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place modifications with O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Standard next permutation pivot detection and suffix inversion.
